title: Unplugs Protect Your Hearing at Loud Concerts: Here’s How to Buy the Premium Earplugs Online
summary: These stylish earplugs make it possible to protect your ears and connect with friends at concerts, sporting events and busy city streets with just a simple click.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

You know that ringing sound you might get after you attend a loud concert? That may be tinnitus, which is a symptom of ear damage that can lead to hearing loss. However, you can protect your ears during noisy events or your daily city commute with these new earplugs.

With prices starting at $65, Unplugs are a premium pair of earplugs that are specifically designed by audiologists to protect your ears from the outside world with a simple click per plug. It’s a way to isolate yourself and protect your hearing, as well as connect to your friends and family during a rip-roaring event at a moment’s notice.

Shop Unplugs

Here’s how the earplugs work: Whenever you’re in a booming and thunderous atmosphere, like a concert, sporting event, on a busy city street or during a flight, click the heads to block out the outside world to isolate yourself by 19dB (decibels). And when you want to connect to the outside world again, give the earplug heads another click to bring in sound.

For example: If you go to a concert or rave that’s around 100dB, Unplugs can reduce the noise level down to about 80dB with one click. In fact, even unclicked, the earplugs can give you up to 7dB of protection just by placing them in your ears.

Unplugs

The earplugs come in four fun colors, including black, silver, nude and iridescent (shown here).

And if you order right now, you get a few free goodies to go along with the Unplugs , as part of their launch. The first gift is a pair of “FitWings” (a $10 value) that wrap around the earplugs to secure them in your ears. The second goodie is a handy “Mag Leash” (a $15 value) that attaches to the earplugs, so you can wear them like a necklace for easy access. This way, you won’t misplace them in your pockets when you’re at a concert.
